class.name: FlowGraphValidation
class.brief_description: The result of [method FlowGraph.validate]: a list of issues.

method.name: get_issue_kind
method.description: Returns the kind of the issue at [param index]. Returns [constant ISSUE_KIND_MAX] and prints an error if [param index] is out of range.

method.name: get_issue_message
method.description: Returns the human-readable, translatable message of the issue at [param index]. Returns an empty string and prints an error if [param index] is out of range.

method.name: get_issue_node_id
method.description: Returns the id of the node the issue at [param index] is about, or [constant FlowGraph.NODE_ID_NONE] if it is about the graph. Prints an error and returns [constant FlowGraph.NODE_ID_NONE] if [param index] is out of range.

method.name: get_issues_for_node
method.description: Returns the indices of all issues about the node [param node_id], to use with [method get_issue_kind] and [method get_issue_message]. Use it to mark a node in an editor.

method.name: is_valid
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if there are no issues.

constants.constant: [member FlowGraph.start_node_id] is not the id of a node of the graph. The node id of the issue is [constant FlowGraph.NODE_ID_NONE].
The node can't be reached from the start node: not by flow connections, and not as a data source of a reached node. Not reported when the start node is missing.

A connection joins a flow port and a data port, or two data ports whose types don't fit. The node id is the target node. [method FlowGraph.connect_nodes] refuses such connections, so this only appears in hand-edited or damaged files.
A connection uses a node or port that does not exist, for example after a node type changed its ports.
A flow output has more than one connection. [method FlowGraph.connect_nodes] refuses this, so it only appears in hand-edited or damaged files.
A [FlowVariableNode] names a variable that is not in [member FlowGraph.variables]. Nodes without a variable name are reported by their own warning instead.
The node is part of a cycle of data connections, so its inputs can never be evaluated. Nodes that are only fed by a cycle are not reported.
A node reports a configuration warning, see [method FlowNode.get_configuration_warnings].
Represents the size of the [enum IssueKind] enum.
